lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，颜色跟着变。
lines.en: I crawl along the ground, my color shifting.

lines.zh: 我爬过石砖，身上就成了石砖的颜色。
lines.en: Crossing stone, I become the color of stone.

lines.zh: 我钻进墙缝，从另一头出来。
lines.en: I slip into a crack and come out the other side.

lines.zh: 我一边爬一边挖，石屑往后飞。
lines.en: I dig as I crawl; chips fly behind me.

lines.zh: 我的手指在土里刨出一条道。
lines.en: My fingers carve a path in the soil.
I come along the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我把自己压扁，挤过窄处。
lines.en: I flatten myself and squeeze through.

lines.zh: 我爬得很低，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I keep low, almost invisible.

lines.zh: 我在墙角和地板之间换了个颜色。
lines.en: Between wall and floor, I change color.

lines.zh: 我一动，身上的纹路就变。
lines.en: When I move, my pattern shifts.
I crawl toward the sound of chickens.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边过去，你不知道。
lines.en: I pass your feet and you do not know.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上，就像墙上的一块。
lines.en: I cling to the wall, part of it.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和身后的砖一样。
lines.en: My color matches the brick behind me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼吸，没有起伏。
lines.en: I breathe without any rise or fall.
I wait without moving.

lines.zh: 我的一根手指在墙上轻轻敲。
lines.en: One of my fingers taps the wall.

lines.zh: 我把身体拉开一点，又缩回。
lines.en: I stretch a little, then draw back.
I am as quiet as you are.

lines.zh: 我身上的纹路慢慢挪动。
lines.en: The pattern on me migrates slowly.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有鸡在叫。
lines.en: I hear a chicken far off.
I show a little from the crack.

lines.zh: 我停在这个角度，很好看。
lines.en: I hold this angle. It looks good.
I press myself flatter.
Against the wall, my color shifts.

lines.zh: 我身上的颜色又深了一层。
lines.en: My color deepens another shade.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转头，脖子转得很远。
lines.en: I turn my head, the neck twisting far.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿从砖缝里抽出来。
lines.en: I draw a leg out of the brick gap.

lines.zh: 我看着自己的手，它换了颜色。
lines.en: I look at my hand; it has changed color.
I am on the wall. You are below.

lines.zh: 你抬头找了一遍，没找到我。
lines.en: You search upward and do not find me.
I am on the brick behind you.

lines.zh: 你转过来的时候，我已经变了色。
lines.en: When you turn, I have changed color.
I work my way down, inch by inch.
Listen. Something is in the wall.
I push my face out of the wall.
You back off. I do not chase.
I move along your shadow.

lines.zh: 你踩到的地方，我刚才在。
lines.en: I was where you just stepped.
I have traced the outline of you once already.
I draw back into the wall.
That patch of color on the wall is me.
I look down at you from very near.
I crawl along the cracks, keeping pace with you.
I drop and curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 我的颜色乱了，一时没配回去。
lines.en: My color scrambles and will not settle.
I dive into the nearest crack.

lines.zh: 我断了一根手指，还会长。
lines.en: I lose a finger. It will regrow.
I shudder; wall dust falls.
I press to the wall and thin out.
I crawl two steps toward the dark.
I recalibrate my color.
I stop and wait for you to leave.
Leave the moldy bread for the pigs.
You set it down. I do not come down.
The chickens are noisy; I'd rather chase you.

lines.zh: 我把它推开，继续贴着墙。
lines.en: I push it away and stay on the wall.
I crawl past it.
I give it one glance.
It is not on my menu.
I crawl around it.
Keep it. I will not move.

lines.zh: 你撞到墙，我从上面掉下来。
lines.en: You hit the wall; I drop from above.
Your touch scrambles my color.
I press back to the wall and recolour.
You step on me; I burrow down.

lines.zh: 我从你的脚背上爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl across the top of your foot.
I bump you, softly.

lines.zh: 你退开时，墙上少了一块影子。
lines.en: As you pull back, a shadow leaves the wall.
I roll into the corner and curl up.

lines.zh: 我把身体摊平，装作地面。
lines.en: I flatten out, pretending to be floor.
I wait for you to leave before moving.
Another is on the other side of the wall.

lines.zh: 我们从缝里对着碰了一下。
lines.en: We touch through the crack.
It takes on my color.

lines.zh: 我们一起在墙上排成一片。
lines.en: We spread across the wall together.
It crosses a hole; I follow.
Our patterns line up.
It stops. I stop.

lines.zh: 我们把墙缝弄宽了一点。
lines.en: We widen the crack a little.
It goes first. I stay behind.

lines.zh: 我们分开，各自变回墙色。
lines.en: We part and each fades back to wall color.
I snatch it and stuff it in a crack.
I pin it with one finger.
It slips out of my grip.
Chewing rotten flesh this long, there's no taste left.
I hide it behind a brick.

lines.zh: 它在我身上留下一个色块。
lines.en: It leaves a patch of color on me.
I drop it and crawl on.
I press it under myself.
I look a long while, then let go.

lines.zh: 我已经在你后面的墙上了。
lines.en: I am already on the wall behind you.
I slowly darken my color.

lines.zh: 你走的那条路，我已经在尽头。
lines.en: The path you take, I am at its end.
I spread my fingers.
I squeeze out of the crack.
You cannot hear me.

lines.zh: 我开始挖墙，朝你的方向。
lines.en: I dig through the wall, toward you.
Footsteps behind the wall; I heard them.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的方向，一直在墙里。
lines.en: I follow your direction, always inside the wall.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就在左边的砖后。
lines.en: You go left; I am behind the brick on the left.
I reach the wall before you do.
You strike the wall; I relocate.
I have dug out your retreat.

lines.zh: 我贴着地板跟在你后面。
lines.en: I keep to the floor behind you.
You should not put your back to the wall.

lines.zh: 钻过深板岩，我还在你后面。
lines.en: Through deepslate I come, still behind you.
You look back; I have just hidden.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和你身后的柜子一样。
lines.en: My color matches the cupboard behind you.
There is a gap where you stand.

lines.zh: 我从墙上扑下来，抓你的脸。
lines.en: I come off the wall and claw your face.

lines.zh: 我从天花板上落下，压在你肩上。
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling onto your shoulders.

lines.zh: 你甩开我，墙上留下一道湿印。
lines.en: You throw me off; a wet streak stays.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在你背上划过。
lines.en: My nails rake your back.

lines.zh: 你把我按在墙上，我还能动。
lines.en: You pin me to the wall, and I still move.
I reach a hand out of a crack.

lines.zh: 你踩到的地方突然动了。
lines.en: The floor under your foot moves.

lines.zh: 我贴上去，皮和皮擦得作响。
lines.en: I press in close, skin rasping on skin.
First I change color to match the wall.
I spread slowly across the brick.
Plenty of cracks here. Good.

lines.zh: 我开始朝有声音的地方爬。
lines.en: I crawl toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我在地上留下一道浅浅的痕。
lines.en: I leave a shallow trail on the floor.
I look for a way up.
I memorize the first corner.
I dig my first tunnel.
I made no sound at all.

lines.zh: 我先把颜色调成这里的样子。
lines.en: I match the color here first.

lines.zh: 我朝最近的鸡窝看过去。
lines.en: I look toward the nearest chicken nest.
I press to the doorframe and wait.

lines.zh: 我从地板缝里露出一点。
lines.en: I show a little through a floorboard gap.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的皮，我钻进墙里。
lines.en: Fire sears my skin; I dive into the wall.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，摊在地上。
lines.en: I fall from a height and splash flat.

lines.zh: 水灌进缝里，我爬不出去。
lines.en: Water pours into the crack; I cannot climb out.

lines.zh: 气浪把墙和一起我掀开。
lines.en: The blast throws the wall and me.
That light stops me from changing color.
Too hungry to climb the wall.
Lightning comes down the crack.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有墙，我抓不住。
lines.en: No walls in the dark. Nothing to grip.
